content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fort Wayne

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Fort Wayne's manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and defense sectors employ thousands of project managers; ensure your background qualifies before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend all required formal education sessions delivered online by active certified practitioners. This structured coursework covers the PMBOK® Guide and exam domains at your own pace from anywhere.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of your 35 contact hours from Granite PM Academy. Pay the associated PMI exam fee and wait for application approval before scheduling your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Test
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence. Schedule your PMP exam with Pearson VUE and sit for the computer-based test. Many candidates complete this step within weeks of bootcamp completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Certification
steps_items.text: Upon passing, you'll earn the PMP credential valid for three years. Maintain it by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through project work, training, volunteer service, or community contributions. Renew with PMI before your cycle expires to keep your credential active.
